tasks.title: H03 Knowledge/PDF Factory architecture canon
Knowledge Package source/evidence/claim contract
Product Blueprint and Document AST contracts
Deterministic PDF renderer v1
PDF reopen, metadata, page and raster visual QA
First bounded Knowledge to PDF deterministic internal proof
Governed external source ingestion adapters
tasks.acceptance: Add source adapters without granting crawlers or LLMs canonical truth; preserve source identity, rights and evidence hashes.

tasks.title: Reusable template and typography registry
tasks.acceptance: Multiple document forms share one AST while template changes do not mutate Knowledge Packages.

tasks.title: web-ai-adapter text capability contract for curator/production roles
tasks.acceptance: H03 calls a normalized text capability contract; provider session/profile bytes remain outside product truth.

tasks.title: H03 shadow economic observation adapter to ECON-002B admission
tasks.acceptance: Map H03 build/research/production observations into ECON-002B validated_not_committed admission envelopes with evidence refs; never directly append ECONOMICS.jsonl and never imply live canonical commit authority.

tasks.title: First external H03 listing/sale canary
tasks.acceptance: After dependencies are green and Founder authorizes publication, publish one bounded external product/listing with product/campaign/economic identities and no paid-ad spend.
tasks.next_action: Wait for H03-QC-001 Founder Product QC. If PASS with publication authorization, provision H03-dedicated Commerce profile and perform seller preflight.

tasks.title: Human Problem Seed contract v1
tasks.acceptance: Define provider-independent human-problem seed identity around persona/context/trigger/job-to-be-done/pain/desired-outcome and explicit commercial-signal placeholders. Topic-only seeds are insufficient; no demand or WTP value may be invented.

tasks.title: H03 role Work Card and durable artifact handoff contract
tasks.acceptance: Define cognition job envelope, role identity, input artifact refs, output artifact contract, idempotency key and terminal states. Standard web-AI workers require neither MCP nor shell/local-filesystem access; those capabilities remain optional future grants.

tasks.title: Human need/pain seed discovery and curation engine
tasks.acceptance: Produce deduplicated problem-seed candidates from governed signal inputs using role-separated web-AI workers; preserve candidate/source lineage and do not promote topic popularity to demand truth.

tasks.title: Demand and willingness-to-pay evidence contract + validator
tasks.acceptance: Represent pain severity/frequency/urgency, buyer intent, existing spend/substitutes, marketplace/community/search evidence and WTP strength with UNKNOWN preserved when unobserved; distinguish revealed spend evidence from weak engagement signals.

tasks.title: Worth-Making and productability gate v1
tasks.acceptance: Deterministically classify a problem seed as MAKE, RESEARCH_MORE or REJECT using bounded demand/WTP/productability evidence. Deep research/production must not start for REJECT.

tasks.title: Provider worker registry and role-routing policy
tasks.acceptance: Define provider-capability/role routing with Qwen 3.8 Max and Gemini as first-class curator/researcher/producer candidates, Manus as autonomous research candidate, and other healthy providers as pluggable alternatives. Routing is based on role/capability/health/capacity rather than fixed account identity.

tasks.title: Persistent browser profile worker-pool and shard contract
tasks.acceptance: Model persistent Brave profiles as runtime shards capable of multiple authenticated web-AI providers via SESSION_API or BROWSER_CDP. Allow one shard initially and alternate healthy shard fallback without copying credential/session bytes into H03 product truth.

tasks.title: Role queues plus fan-out/fan-in continuity state machine
tasks.acceptance: Implement curator/research/synthesis/producer queues with durable artifacts as continuity, idempotent dispatch, bounded fan-out/fan-in and no dependency on continuing the same provider chat thread.

tasks.title: Worker retry, backpressure, fallback and anti-stall policy
tasks.acceptance: Bound retries; distinguish auth/rate-limit/provider/runtime failures; circuit-break unhealthy worker slots; route eligible jobs to alternate provider/profile; expose backlog/backpressure instead of silent stalls.

tasks.title: Mission Control to H03 batch-supervision boundary
tasks.acceptance: Mission Control supervises H03 batch/product lifecycle, durable checkpoints, Founder gates, failure escalation and recovery while H03 orchestrator owns cognition microjobs. MCP/Mission Protocol must not be required for every worker prompt.

tasks.title: Dedicated headful H03 browser workforce + Mission Control bridge binding
tasks.acceptance: Provision H03-owned Knowledge/Review/Growth persistent profiles, prove controlled restart/session persistence, enforce headful demand-driven lifecycle and foreign-profile prohibition, and bind by logical identity to Mission Control supervisor bridge without persisting session material.

tasks.title: Restart-safe Artifact Courier and cross-process semantic continuity
tasks.acceptance: Persist every accepted Web-AI handoff as a content-addressed H03 artifact plus result receipt and queue checkpoint; prove a downstream role can reload and consume the artifact after the upstream process exits, without shared chat memory or worker filesystem access.

tasks.title: Live public-source gate and production organism runner readiness
tasks.acceptance: Verify public research URLs independently with bounded HTTP(S) fetching, SSRF/private-network rejection, source hashing, evidence-unit extraction and reference-only rights governance; exercise the complete A-K organism DAG with fake cognition but real deterministic Demand/WTP, Worth-Making, synthesis normalization, product planning, PDF render/QA/package and Founder QC gate.

tasks.title: First live Web-AI problem-to-package organism
tasks.acceptance: Run one bounded live A-K organism from opportunity brief through seed curation, verified market evidence, Demand/WTP, Worth-Making, deep research, synthesis, Knowledge Package, Product Architecture, semantic production, deterministic PDF package and independent review. Stop honestly if Worth-Making or evidence gates fail. If review passes, stop at WAITING_FOUNDER_QC. No listing, social publication, paid ads or spend.
tasks.next_action: Execute bin/h03_live_org.py against H03 dedicated operational profiles and Mission Control H03 supervisor bridge.

tasks.title: H03 live canonical economics commit activation boundary
tasks.acceptance: Only after Company-level authority explicitly exists, connect validated H03 admissions to the sole die-state-manager commit path; no second writer and no autonomous spend/payment authority.

tasks.title: Deep Research Work Card, source classes and stop-policy contract
tasks.acceptance: Define research questions, source classes, evidence requirements, contradiction tracking, WTP/market subquestions, bounded budget and diminishing-return stop conditions. Research breadth is sufficient-confidence driven, not crawl-the-entire-internet literalism.

tasks.title: Parallel multi-provider research fan-out execution
tasks.acceptance: Dispatch bounded research subjobs to eligible providers such as Qwen/Gemini/Manus, ingest their source/evidence outputs through KF-002, and emit independently addressable research packets with typed terminal status.

tasks.title: Research synthesis fan-in to Knowledge Map and Knowledge Package candidate
tasks.acceptance: Consolidate multiple research packets into supported findings, contradictions, gaps, market/WTP findings and claim/evidence links. Model synthesis remains non-canonical until Knowledge Factory validation accepts the package.

tasks.title: Useful Product Planner and format-selection engine
tasks.acceptance: Choose outcome-oriented delivery form (guide/checklist/workbook/playbook/report/template/etc.) from problem/knowledge structure and emit Product Blueprint. Do not optimize for page count or default every opportunity to ebook.

tasks.title: Role-separated semantic producer fan-out to content blocks
tasks.acceptance: Dispatch bounded producer sections/jobs to eligible web-AI workers, preserve Knowledge Package refs, and emit structured content blocks. Producers never own PDF mechanics or canonical provenance.

tasks.title: Deterministic useful-product compile, QA and local package
tasks.acceptance: Assemble content blocks into Document AST, render selected template, run technical/raster QA, generate hashes/manifests and produce a local sale-ready product package without external publication.

tasks.title: Bounded end-to-end problem-to-package internal canary
tasks.acceptance: Run one bounded real problem candidate through curation, demand/WTP, research fan-out, synthesis, product planning, production, compile and package with durable lineage; no external listing or promotion.

tasks.title: Independent product review + Founder Review Card
tasks.acceptance: Produce concise review card with buyer/problem/promise, product preview, evidence confidence, risk/rights flags, market/WTP basis and PASS/REVISE/REJECT decision surface. Prefer reviewer separation from dominant producer where capacity permits.

tasks.title: Founder Product QC and explicit release decision
tasks.acceptance: Founder inspects the actual product package and records PASS/REVISE/REJECT, rights release state, and an explicit publication_authorized boolean. Independent reviewer PASS cannot satisfy this gate.

tasks.title: Channel-neutral Commerce Package + multi-channel eligibility/router matrix
tasks.acceptance: Generate one platform-neutral offer identity, pricing hypothesis, rights/disclosure and listing lineage; route by product form/artifact/vertical/platform state across a governed channel registry; emit platform listing drafts including Gumroad/Etsy without live publication; identify derivative-required surfaces instead of blindly broadcasting incompatible files.

tasks.title: Product/campaign/channel attribution event contract
tasks.acceptance: Define product_id/listing_id/campaign_id/creative_id/channel plus UTM/referrer identity so click/order/revenue observations can be joined back to the originating problem seed without inventing unobserved conversions.

tasks.title: Organic Growth Blueprint and channel-native content atomizer
tasks.acceptance: Transform accepted product knowledge into channel-native promotion briefs/atoms for X, Threads, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest and Reddit while retaining product/campaign lineage. Paid ads remain disabled.

tasks.title: Social distribution runtime and separate persistent-profile pool contract
tasks.acceptance: Define Growth browser-profile pool separately from Knowledge workforce, with BROWSER_CDP as viable initial transport and pluggable future official API/social-manager adapters. Credential/session bytes remain host-local.

tasks.title: Marketplace/social/direct-checkout analytics observation + aggregation
tasks.acceptance: Normalize read-only Gumroad/Etsy/social observations such as views/clicks/orders/revenue/conversion/referrer where available into evidence-linked H03 analytics records; missing platform metrics stay UNKNOWN.

tasks.title: Demand/WTP feedback loop from observed channel/product outcomes
tasks.acceptance: Join observed marketplace/social outcomes back to problem seeds and demand hypotheses for later score calibration without treating correlation or missing data as causation.

tasks.title: First bounded organic promotion canary
tasks.acceptance: After Founder authorizes accounts/publication, publish a bounded organic promotion set with campaign/creative/channel identities and no paid-ad spend; collect read-only analytics observations.
tasks.next_action: Wait for Founder Product QC and live DIST-001; then use H03-dedicated Growth profile only.

tasks.title: Bounded multi-product internal throughput and resilience soak
tasks.acceptance: Run a bounded internal batch sized by current safe capacity, not a fixed product-count target. Measure throughput, queue latency, terminal failure rate, retry count, fallback success, provider/profile bottlenecks and resource usage; no external publication.

revision: 2026-09-11 H03-RT-008 artifact continuity PASS; H03-RT-009 live-source/full-DAG readiness PASS; Mission Control H03 bridge accepted production-ready; H03-LIVE-ORG-001 READY.

production_organism.control_plane: Mission Control supervises batches/products, recovery, gates and durable standing; it does not execute every prompt.
production_organism.worker_plane: H03 role queues dispatch normalized cognition jobs through web-ai-adapter; MCP is not a worker hot-path requirement.
production_organism.profile_policy: One persistent multi-provider Brave profile may be the initial shard; add/fallback to another healthy shard when observed capacity or failure requires it.
